# AERO-SENTINEL

> Professional aviation weather monitoring platform providing real-time TAF, METAR, and SPECI alerts for pilots, dispatchers, and aviation professionals.

## Site Information

- **URL**: https://aerosentinel.app
- **Type**: Web Application (SPA)
- **Category**: Aviation Weather Monitoring
- **Language**: English

## Key Pages

- [Dashboard](https://aerosentinel.app/) — Real-time TAF/METAR monitoring dashboard with personalized airport watchlists
- [Alerts](https://aerosentinel.app/alerts) — Weather alert management and history for watchlist airports
- [Airports](https://aerosentinel.app/airports) — Global airport weather data browser and flight analysis tool
- [Blog](https://aerosentinel.app/blog) — Aviation weather guides and educational articles
- [Features](https://aerosentinel.app/features) — Platform feature overview and descriptions
- [Use Cases](https://aerosentinel.app/use-cases) — How different aviation professionals use AERO-SENTINEL
- [FAQ](https://aerosentinel.app/faq) — Frequently asked questions about the platform
- [About](https://aerosentinel.app/about) — About AERO-SENTINEL

## Data Sources

All weather data originates from official ICAO-standard aviation weather sources. METAR and TAF reports are issued by certified weather observers and licensed meteorologists at airport meteorological stations worldwide.

## Features

- Real-time TAF/METAR monitoring with instant change detection
- SPECI and weather change alerts via browser push notifications
- Personalized airport watchlists (stored locally, no account required)
- Decoded weather data with human-readable translations
- Flight category classification (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR)
- Historical TAF change tracking and trend analysis
- PWA support for mobile and kiosk use

## Allowed Paths

- All public pages are open to crawling and indexing
- API endpoints (`/api/*`) are not intended for LLM access
